study: F2 WP2.2 - media (troposphere + ionosphere) in the production barycentric two-way range (MEAS-06)
source_of_predeclaration: docs/assurance/vv-program.md F2 table (WP2.2 row); Phase C5 materiality (2-12 m two-way range, 66 sigma) and C5-I module (lunar_od.media, media_partials)
scope_slice_1: scenario field media_model = 'none' (default) | 'default_climatology'; accepted only with measurement_model_profile='two_way_light_time_ssb'; routes lunar_od.media.MediaModel() into relativistic_light_time.generate_two_way_range_measurements_ssb, whose metadata carries it to the residual and Jacobian

G3_bls_recovery_with_media.rule: noise-free BLS-LM on media-bearing SSB two-way range from an 80 m / 0.02 m/s offset recovers position < 1 cm (elevation >= 10 deg rows)

G4_media_materiality.rule: the same data scored without media at the truth: mean residual in band

G5_fail_closed.rule: media_model other than 'none' rejected unless the profile is two_way_light_time_ssb; unknown values rejected

amendments.change: position < 1 cm -> position < 3 cm and <= 1.5 x the vacuum (barycentric_dsn) control on the same rows; velocity < 1e-5 m/s and <= 1.5 x control
amendments.reason: FAIL as computed: 1.77 cm (J-Stab exit). The vacuum control on the same 118 rows gives 2.07 cm (converged): only Canberra is above 10 deg on the 1 h fixture arc, so single-station Doppler geometry, not the media, sets the floor. The media Jacobian matches central differences to 5.1e-8 relative (same as vacuum)

reject_if: any gate fails as computed, or a frozen default-path baseline changes
scope_slice_2: counted Doppler media: counted_doppler_model='barycentric_dsn_media' = barycentric_dsn plus lunar_od.media.MediaModel() phase delays on both legs (relativistic_light_time.counted_doppler(media=...)); BLS-LM/SRIF only

G6_bls_recovery_doppler_media.rule: noise-free BLS-LM on barycentric_dsn_media counted Doppler (elevation >= 10 deg) from an 80 m / 0.02 m/s offset recovers position < 1 cm and velocity < 1e-5 m/s

G7_doppler_media_materiality.rule: barycentric_dsn (vacuum) at the truth misfits the media data: RMS in band (C5: troposphere rate ~ zhd * dm/dt; 1e-5 to 1e-2 m/s)

G8_jacobian_vs_central_differences.rule: media Jacobian row vs central differences of re-propagated arcs (10 m / 1e-2 m/s steps)

G9_fail_closed.rule: barycentric_dsn_media rejected with the UKF, the legacy station grid and non-Doppler modes

scope_slice_3: elevation refraction (MEAS-07) for the position observables: lunar_od.media.refraction_coefficients = port of SOFA iauRefco (radio branch, standard-atmosphere pressure at the station height, 10 C, 50 % relative humidity); apparent el = true el + A cot(el) + B cot^3(el), solved by fixed point; opt in with scenario media_model='default_climatology' for measurement_type='position' (BLS-LM/SRIF; the UKF fails closed); generation adds it, compute_position_residuals adds it, the analytic Jacobian scales the elevation row by d(el_app)/d(el)

G10_refco_vs_erfa.oracle: pyerfa refco in agent-sandbox/c2-erfa-reference, fixture studies/phase17/results/wp2_2_erfa_refco.npz (pressure x temperature x humidity x wavelength grid)

G11_refraction_magnitude.rule: refraction at 10 deg elevation, sea level standard atmosphere, radio: 4-8 arcmin (published radio refraction ~5-6 arcmin)

G12_jacobian_elevation_row.rule: d(el_app)/d(el) from the analytic factor vs central differences of the refraction map, |diff| < 1e-8

G13_bls_recovery_with_refraction.rule: noise-free BLS-LM on refracted position data (elevation >= 10 deg) recovers position < 1 cm; the unrefracted model at the truth misfits the elevation by RMS in band

G14_fail_closed.rule: position media_model rejected with the UKF
